status: Superseded by round 04: user confirmed adding credits and requested original redesigns for all six. This library batch was not generated.
generation_plan: One three-beat audition per candidate, Chuck first; no automatic retries or permanent voice creation. Character scripts are proposed and have not been approved.

candidates.name: Chuck Miller - Deep, Raspy, American
candidates.reason_and_rejection_test: User likes the existing preview. Test whether its roughness survives pleasure, anger and quiet guilt. North Jersey specificity is still unverified.

script.text: Oh, I missed this. Being understood.
script.delivery: Warm, greedy pleasure; breathe before the second sentence.

script.context: recent enemy damage, after reaching a brief safe window
script.text: You little shit. This was my good side.
script.delivery: A startled bark, then offended vanity; not a growled slogan.

script.context: quiet Keene confession after the cage evidence
script.text: He asked me to wait. I heard him. I left anyway.
script.delivery: No menace. No clever finish. Plain admission.

candidates.name: Charmion - Soft and husky
candidates.reason_and_rejection_test: British character voice with a husky description. Reject if it stays soft or breathy through anger; the preview must earn a script audition.

script.text: Oh, that's indecent. Give it here.
script.delivery: Private delight followed by sudden possession.

script.context: costume-damage acting exercise only; no gameplay feature implied
script.text: You tore my sleeve. I made that. I MADE that!
script.delivery: Disbelief rising to disproportionate fury; let the voice become untidy.

script.text: Play it again. Please. I need to hear if it's him.
script.delivery: Drop the stage voice; the request is hard to make.

candidates.name: Kathie - Sassy & Playful
candidates.reason_and_rejection_test: American character voice described as sarcastic with comedic timing and spoiled attitude. Reject if it only supplies a bright commercial or generic brat voice; huskiness remains unverified.

script.context: first acquisition from a known private stash, not a purchase
script.text: Oh, he was saving this. That's adorable.
script.delivery: Enjoy the theft; let the affection be outrageous but sincere.

script.context: a failed attempt to negotiate with Voss in an authored exchange
script.text: Don't sweetheart me. I'm the one who does that.
script.delivery: Immediate offended interruption; warmth snaps off.

script.context: quiet admission about Tomas after the relevant backstory is revealed
script.text: I keep sending money. He keeps sending it back. I don't know what else to send.
script.delivery: Lose the sales rhythm; she cannot buy an easy ending.

candidates.name: Monty - Theatrical Aristocratic Villain
candidates.reason_and_rejection_test: Older East Coast American theatrical villain. Test authority and pleasure; reject a frail caricature, a constant sneer or a radio monologue. The catalog age is older than Voss’s target.

script.context: welcome, before the crew knows the transfer scheme
script.text: There you are. I was beginning to feel stood up. And after all this trouble.
script.delivery: Delighted host; final phrase carries a personal grievance.

script.context: a crew member refuses him after an authored bargain confrontation
script.text: No? You came into my house to say no to me? ... How refreshing.
script.delivery: First real crack of disbelief, then hospitality forcibly restored.

script.context: optional quiet admission about Helena after that history is introduced
script.text: I knew everything she liked. Apparently that was not the same as listening.
script.delivery: A little wounded and annoyed at the truth; no villain laugh.
